reason: A client-side DeepSeek Harness theme plugin focused on interface customization, including configurable backgrounds, sidebar styling, draggable artwork, and status-based dialogue display.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供可配置的日夜背景、透明度、模糊效果、可拖动立绘和状态台词主题美化。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web interface theme that provides configurable day/night backgrounds, opacity and blur settings, draggable character artwork, and status-based dialogue.

capabilities: Modifies the DeepSeek Harness web interface appearance and layout
Adds configurable day/night backgrounds, opacity, blur, and draggable character artwork
Displays status-dependent animations and dialogue bubbles based on agent state
Injects bundled CSS and client-side theme logic into the web client
